title: Cold rebuild: an append-only log
summary: Rebuild the event log with consumer groups from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **An append-only log with consumer groups** in *Commands, events and logs*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: A log holds offsets 0 to 9 (`EndOffset` is 10). Group `billing` has committed offset 7. A new group `fraud` joins with `auto.offset.reset = latest`. What are the two lags?
steps.explain: Lag is log-end offset minus the group's position: 10 − 7 = 3. A new group on *latest* starts at the log end, so its lag is 0, and it will never see offsets 0 to 9 unless it seeks back.

steps.title: Rebuild the event log cold
prompt: Write a class `EventLog` (an append-only log with consumer groups):
- `long Append(string value)`: appends and returns the record's offset (`0`, `1`, `2`, ...).
- `long EndOffset`: the offset the next record will get.
- `void Join(string group, bool fromEarliest)`: a new group starts at `0` when `fromEarliest`, else at
`EndOffset`. Joining an existing group changes nothing.
- `List<string> Poll(string group, int max)`: up to `max` records from the group's position, then moves the
position past them. A group that never joined throws `InvalidOperationException`.
- `long Lag(string group)`: `EndOffset` minus the group's position.
- `void Seek(string group, long offset)`: moves the position; below `0` or above `EndOffset` throws
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
public void Join(string group, bool fromEarliest) { }
public List<string> Poll(string group, int max) => new();
public void Seek(string group, long offset) { }
